camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi DescribeResourceUsageDetail --region cn-hangzhou --PeriodType HOUR --NextToken eyJwYWdlTnVtIjoyLCJwYWdlU2l6ZSI6MTB9 --EndPeriod '2021-01-02_00:00:00' --MaxResults 200 --BillOwnerId 123745698925000 --ResourceType RI --StartPeriod '2021-01-01_00:00:00'
description_en: Queries the usage details of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs)
description_zh: 预留实例、SCU使用率明细查询
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi describe-resource-usage-detail --start-period 2021-01-01_00:00:00 --end-period 2021-01-02_00:00:00 --period-type HOUR --next-token eyJwYWdlTnVtIjoyLCJwYWdlU2l6ZSI6MTB9 --max-results 200 --bill-owner-id 123745698925000 --resource-type RI --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceUsageDetail

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The beginning is included in the time range. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss； 查询逻辑为包括该时间
parameters.name: start_period

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end is excluded from the time range. If you do not set this parameter, the end time is the current time. Specify the time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；查询逻辑为不包括该时间；为空表示截止到当前时间
parameters.name: end_period

parameters.help_en: The time granularity at which usage details are queried. Valid values: MONTH, DAY, and HOUR
parameters.help_zh: MONTH：月维度； DAY：天维度； HOUR：小时维度；
parameters.name: period_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
parameters.help_zh: 分页token，首页查询时传空，查询结果中返回下一页token地址。当结果token为空时表示全部查完
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Default value: 20. The maximum value is 300
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：20，最大值：300
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account whose data you want to query. If you do not specify this parameter, the data of the current Alibaba Cloud account and its Resource Access Management (RAM) users is queried. To query the data of a RAM user, specify the ID of the RAM user
parameters.help_zh: 如果为空查询当前账号及其托管子账号的数据，可传入托管子账号ID，明确查询该子账号数据
parameters.name: bill_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The type of deduction plan whose usage details are queried. Valid values: RI and SCU
parameters.help_zh: 资源包类型。枚举值：RI：预留实例；SCU：存储容量单位包
parameters.name: resource_type
